ITEM 1 | White cooked grains, moist and clumped with loose separate strands, creamy-white with slight sheen, forming a mound about 7 cm across and 2.5 cm tall on the left side of the plate | 150
ITEM 2 | Brown pan-seared meat piece, irregular oval about 6 cm by 4 cm, 1.5 cm thick, dark caramelized browned exterior with pinkish-red interior edges, slightly glossy and juicy, sitting beside the rice | 90
ITEM 3 | Two elongated strips of browned meat with a fibrous, ridged texture, golden-brown to dark edges, lightly glossy, one strip about 9 cm long and 2 cm wide, the other about 7 cm long, stacked near the upper right of the plate with a few thin pale fatty bits | 110
